title: 第二十五章 庄家的麻烦第二十六章 内院
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
屋里几人立刻站起身，躬身行礼：“见过林大爷，林二爷。”
林文贤摆了摆手，脸上没什么笑意，语气平和：
“都坐吧，找你们过来，是有件事要跟你们说清楚。”
几人依言坐下，目光都落在林文贤身上，心里隐隐有了猜测，却没吭声。
林文贤端起桌上的茶杯，抿了一口：“我林家的家底，你们也清楚，我们根基浅，养不起太多武者。
张小乙的天赋，你们都看在眼里，林家会倾尽资源培养他。至于你们……”
他顿了顿，目光扫过众人：
“就算你们日后能扣关成功，踏入明劲，林家也可能不会再聘请你们。
你们和林家签的资助契约，只有三个月，已经过去一个半月了，再有一个半月，这些林家都会停了。
这几个月，就当我林家跟你们结个善缘，日后林家若是有难，你们能顺手帮一把，就够了。”
这话一出，雅间里静了片刻，却没人出声反驳，也没人面露怨色。
从张小乙突破明劲开始，他们就都猜到了这个结果。
王浩率先点了点头，说道：“林大爷放心，若是没有林家，我们这辈子都没机会进武馆，更别说碰武道的门槛。这份恩情，我们记着。
日后林家有用得着的地方，我们一定会帮。”
其他几个少年也纷纷点头附和。
他们心里清楚，就算林家停了资助，只要能踏入明劲，在安陆县根本不愁出路。
明劲武者走到哪，都有口饭吃，林家给了他们进门的机会，他们已经足够感激。
林文贤看着众人的反应，脸上露出一丝笑意，点了点头：
“好，你们能明白就好。
话我已经说到了，你们也早点回去吧，好好练功，武道之路，终究还是要靠自己走。”

几人躬身行礼，转身退出了雅间。
出了聚福楼，夜色正浓，几人站在路口，各有心思。
王浩没多说什么，拱了拱手，转身就往武馆的方向走，显然是憋着一股劲。
秦苏早就料到了这个结果，林家本就是逐利的，张小乙的天赋摆在那里，他们自然会倾向他。
自己就算现在显露明劲实力，林家也未必会改变主意。
几人分开，秦苏回了外城的家。
一夜无话，第二天一早，他照旧来到武馆。
日头爬到半空，歇晌的时候，庄成终于来了。
他穿着一身洗得发白的短褂，脸色泛黄，眼底带着浓重的黑眼圈，整个人蔫蔫的，没了往日的精气神。
他走到秦苏面前，从怀里掏出一个布包，递了过来：“秦师兄，这是这个月的三两银子，我爹让我给你送过来。”
秦苏接过布包，掂了掂。
他看着庄成这副样子，眉头皱了起来。
算起来，已经快十天没见庄成来武馆练功了，往日里也能看见庄成天天来武馆，从不会缺席这么久。
“你这阵子怎么没来武馆？”秦苏开口问道，“出什么事了？”
庄成身子一颤，嘴唇动了动，半天没说出话来。
他摆了摆手，勉强挤出一个笑：
“没……没什么事，就是家里有点杂事，耽误了。秦师兄，银子送到了，我就先回去了。”
他说着，转身就要走，满是愁苦。
秦苏一步上前，伸手抓住了他的胳膊。
庄成的胳膊抖得厉害，秦苏看着他，语气沉了几分：

“到底出什么事了？你刚才念叨，要是我是武者就好了，这话是什么意思？
庄家遇到麻烦了？”
庄成猛的抬起头，眼里瞬间泛起了泪花，看着秦苏，嘴唇哆嗦着：
“秦师兄……要是你是武者就好了……要是你是武者，庄家就不会被人逼到这份上了……”
content_en:
Several people in the room immediately stood up and bowed and saluted: "I have met Uncle Lin, Second Master Lin."
Lin Wenxian waved his hand, with no smile on his face and a calm tone:
"Everyone, take a seat. I'm here to find you. I have something to explain to you."
Several people sat down as they were told, their eyes falling on Lin Wenxian. They had vague guesses in their hearts, but they didn't say anything.
Lin Wenxian picked up the teacup on the table and took a sip: "You also know the financial background of my Lin family. We have a shallow foundation and cannot support too many warriors.
You all see Zhang Xiaoyi's talent, and the Lin family will devote all their resources to cultivating him. As for you..."
He paused and glanced at everyone:
"Even if you can successfully pass the test and enter Mingjin in the future, the Lin family may not hire you again.
The funding contract you signed with the Lin family is only for three months. One and a half months have passed. In another month and a half, the Lin family will stop.
In the past few months, I, the Lin family, have formed a good relationship with you. If the Lin family is in trouble in the future, it will be enough if you can help me. "
As soon as these words came out, the private room was quiet for a moment, but no one spoke out to refute, and no one showed any complaints.
They had all guessed this result since Zhang Xiaoyi broke through Ming Jin.
Wang Hao took the lead and nodded and said: "Uncle Lin, don't worry, if it weren't for the Lin family, we would never have the chance to enter a martial arts gym in this life, let alone touch the threshold of martial arts. We will remember this kindness."
In the future, if the Lin family is of any use, we will definitely help. "
Several other teenagers nodded in agreement.
They knew in their hearts that even if the Lin family stopped funding, as long as they could enter Mingjin, they would not have to worry about a way out in Anlu County.
Ming Jin warriors always had something to eat wherever they went. The Lin family gave them the opportunity to enter, and they were grateful enough.
Lin Wenxian looked at everyone's reactions, with a smile on his face and nodded:
"Okay, as long as you understand.
I have already said it, you should go back early and practice well. After all, you still have to walk the road of martial arts on your own. "
Several people bowed, turned around and exited the private room.
After leaving Jufu Tower, the night was getting dark, and several people were standing at the intersection, each with their own thoughts.
Wang Hao didn't say anything more, he cupped his hands, turned around and walked towards the martial arts hall, obviously holding back his energy.
Qin Su had already expected this result. The Lin family was originally profit-seeking. Where Zhang Xiaoyi's talent was, they would naturally lean towards him.
Even if he shows his strength now, the Lin family may not change his mind.
The few people separated, and Qin Su returned to his home in the outer city.
The whole night was silent, and early the next morning, he came to the martial arts gym as usual.
The sun climbed into the sky, and when it was time to rest, Zhuang Cheng finally arrived.
He was wearing a short coat that had been washed white, his face was yellow, and there were thick dark circles under his eyes. His whole person was wilted and lacked the energy of the past.
He walked up to Qin Su, took out a cloth bag from his arms, and handed it over: "Senior Brother Qin, here are three taels of silver for this month. My father asked me to deliver it to you."
Qin Su took the cloth bag and weighed it.
Looking at Zhuang Cheng's appearance, he frowned.
In total, it has been almost ten days since I saw Zhuang Cheng coming to the martial arts gym to practice. In the past, I could see Zhuang Cheng coming to the martial arts gym every day, and he would never be absent for so long.
"Why haven't you come to the martial arts gym this time?" Qin Su asked, "What happened?"
Zhuang Cheng's body trembled, his lips moved, and he didn't say anything for a long time.
He waved his hand and forced a smile:
"No... nothing happened. I just had some chores at home and I was delayed. Senior Brother Qin, I'll go back first after the money has been delivered."
He said this and turned to leave, full of sorrow.
Qin Su stepped forward and reached out to grab his arm.
Zhuang Cheng's arms were shaking violently. Qin Su looked at him and said in a darker tone:
"What happened? You just said, It would be great if I were a warrior. What do you mean?
The dealer is in trouble? "
Zhuang Cheng MengHe raised his head, tears instantly filled his eyes, looked at Qin Su, and his lips trembled:
"Senior Brother Qin... If only you were a warrior... If you were a warrior, the dealer wouldn't be forced into this..."
